apāpurati.p: [Apa+ā+pura+a+ti] (kri) Google Translate In Sanskrit, there is an apavinati with vidha. William: See. Open-up. Yellow Purati - See also
a: အပါပုရတိ(ကြိ)
သက္ကတ၌ ဝိဓာတ်ဖြင့် အပါဝိဏောတိ-ဟု ရှိသည်။ ဝီလျှံ-ကြည့်။]  ဖွင့်၏၊ လှစ်-ဖွင့်-၏။ အဝါပုရတိ-လည်းကြည့်။

C: apāpurati：apāpuṇati [Sk. apāvṛṇoti，apa-ā-vṛ] 開門. pp. apāruta； pass. apāpurīyati. cf. avāpurati.
B:
apāpurati：apāpurati（kri）
အပါပုရတိ（ကြိ）
[apa+ā+pura+a+ti. sakkatanitea vi apāviṇoti-hu rhi. vīlyhaṃ-.]
[အပ+အာ+ပုရ+အ+တိ။ သက္ကတ၌ ဝိဓာတ်ဖြင့် အပါဝိဏောတိ-ဟု ရှိသည်။ ဝီလျှံ-ကြည့်။]
P: Apāpurati，& Apāpuṇati [Sk. apāvṛṇoti，apa + ā + vṛ，but Vedic only apa-vṛṇoti corresponding to Lat. aperio = *apa-ǔerio. On form see Trenckner，Notes 63] to open （a door） Vin.I，5 （apāpur’etaṁ Amatassa dvāraṁ：imper.； where id. p. S.I，137 has avāpur°，T.，but v. l. apāpur°）； Vv 6427 （apāpuranto Amatassa dvāraṁ，expld. at VvA.284 by vivaranto）； It.80 （apāvuṇanti A. dv. as T. conj.，with v. l. apānuṁanti，apāpurenti & apāpuranti）. -- pp. apāruta （q. v.）. -- Pass. apāpurīyati [cp. BSk. apāvurīyati M Vastu II.158] to be opened M.III，184 （v. l. avā°）； J.I，63 （avā°）； Th.2，494 （apāpuṇitvā）. See also avāpurati. （Page 54）
K:

[အပ+အာ+ပုရ+အ+တိ။ သက္ကတ၌ ဝိဓာတ်ဖြင့် အပါဝိဏောတိ-ဟု ရှိသည်။ ဝီလျှံ-ကြည့်။]

R: apāpurati：အပါပုရတိ အဝါပုရတိ
DOP: apāpurati ( and avāpurati) pr. 3 sg. [ for *apāvurati < *apāvarati with labialisation; cf S. apāvṛṇoti], opens (a door) ; Vin I 5, 31* (apāpur’ etaṃ amatassa dvāraṃ; Sp 962, 17 : vivara etaṃ) = M I 168, 27* = S I 137, 23* ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee avāpur’) quoted Sadd 430, 6 (avāpur’); It 80, 5* (~anti amatassa dvāraṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee conjecture apāvuṇanti); Sadd 430, 11 (avāpuranti vivaranti dvāraṃ etenā ti avāpuraṇaṃ); — part.pr. apāpuranta, mfn. , Vv 64:27 (~antaṃ amatassa dvāraṃ, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee avāpurantaṃ); Ja VI 373, 14* (atthassa dvārāni avāpuranto, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se apāpurento); — inf. apāpurituṃ, Vin II 148, 19 (bhikkhū na sakkonti kavāṭaṃ ~ituṃ); — absol. apāpuritvā, M I 30, 30 ; Thī 494 (dvāraṃ ~itvā, so read with App II, p. 248; Be apāpuritvāna; Ce avāpuritvā; Ee, Se wr apāpuṇitvāna); Ja II 22, 9 (~itvā, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee avāpuritvā); — pass. 3 sg. apāpurīyati, avāpurīyati [ cf BHS apāvurīyati], M III 184, 10 (puratthimadvāraṃ ~īyati); Ja I 63, 6 (sace dvāraṃ na avāpurīyati, Ce, Ee so; Be vivarīyati; Se vivareyya); — aor. 3 sg. avāpurīyittha, Ja I 63, 15 (sace dvāraṃ na avāpurīyittha yathācintitaṃ eva tīsu janesu aññataro sampādeyya, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se apārupayittha); — pp apāruta , mfn. [ S. apāvṛta], open, opened ; D II 217, 15 (~ā amatassa dvārā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr apārūtā) ≠ M I 169, 24* quoted Sadd 459, 27 ; Vv 52:3; — ~-ghara, mfn. , living with open doors ; D I 135, 28 (Sv 297, 8 : ~-gharā ti corānaṃ abhāvena dvārāni asaṃvaritvā vivaṭadvārā ti attho); — ~-dvāra, mfn. , with open doors ; Ja I 264, 4 (~-dvāre nivesane); — caus. absol. avāpurāpetvā, Ja I 263, 30 ( Ce, Ee, Se so; Be vivarāpetvā).
CPD: apâpurati , pr. 3 sg., sometimes written avâ- purati [ from *apāvurati, sa. apa + ā + √vṛ; p-p for p-v as in palāpa, opilāpeti ( Tr. Notes 63); *vurati, sixth present class , Whitney § 756; for vowel degree see Ai Gr l § 21, ( a ) -b; Sadd 430, 5-13 books it under √pur], to open ( a door ) ; 3 pl. ~anti amatassa dvāraṃ, lt 80, 5 * ( so Mss. Se S e for apāvuṇanti E e , which was conjectured ( cf. āvuṇati) for B apāmu- ṇanti, cf. apāpuṇitvāna above; = ugghāṭenti ama- tassa nibbānassa dvāraṃ ariyamaggaṃ, lt-a); part, m. avāpuranto (atthassa dvārāni), Ja Vl 373, 14 * ( no apâpurati (= ariyamaggaṃ vivarantaṃ, Vv-a 284, 11-13 , v. l. avāp°); imper. 2 sg. ~a, Vin l 5, 31 * (apâpur' etaṃ amatassa dvāraṃ) = MN l 168, 27 * (= vivara, Ps; ≠ MN ll 93(20*)) = SN l 137, 23 * ( E e avâpur', but see v. l.; = vivara, Spk; quoted Sadd 430, 6 ) ≠ Mvu lll 317, 17 * (Tuneld, Recherches p. 161; codd. +apa- vṛtamam°) ≠ ( retouched ) Lal 398, 17 *; inf. ~ituṃ, Vin ll 148, 19 (na sakkonti kavāṭaṃ ~); abs. (a ) ~itvā, MN l 30, 30 (= vivaritvā, Ps); ( b ) ~itvāna, Thī 494 ( E e w. r. apâpuṇitvāna); pp. apāruta, caus , apâpu- rāpeti, pass , apâpurīyati ( q. v. ).
NCP: pr. 3 sg | apaapurati opens ( a door) See also: avāpurati

apāpa.p: [Na+pāpa] (ti) Google Translate (1) Not evil - not inferior - not inferior - dirty; Good, sublime, pure, He: (a) A person who is glorious, diligent and courageous. Good man. (B) His Holiness. He is a good person. (C) A noble person. Apapurakkhara: See: (2) the opposite of evil, free from evil; Good, sublime, pure, Things: (a) The nine noble Dhammas of the world. (B) The noble benefits and bliss. Apapurakkhara - See.

apāpa：＂အပါပ（တိ）
[န+ပါပ]
（၁） မယုတ်မာ-မယုတ်နိမ့်-မယုတ်ညစ်-သော၊ ကောင်းမွန်-မြင့်မြတ်-စင်ကြယ်-သော၊ သူ။ （က） ဘုန်းကံ-လုံ့လ-သတ္တိ-ရှိသော သူ၊ အမျိုးကောင်းသား။ （ခ） သူတော်သူမြတ်၊ သူတော်ကောင်း။ （ဂ） အရိယာပုဂ္ဂိုလ်။ အပါပပုရေက္ခာရ-ကြည့်။ （၂） မကောင်းမှု၏ ဆန့်ကျင်ဖက် ဖြစ်သော မကောင်းမှုမှ ကင်းသော၊ ကောင်းမွန်-မြင့်မြတ်-စင်ကြယ်-သော၊ အရာ။ （က） မြတ်သော လောကုတ္တရာတရား ကိုးပါး။ （ခ） မြတ်သော အကျိုးစီးပွါး ချမ်းသာသုခ။ အပါပပုရေက္ခာရ-ကြည့်။
DOP: pāpa mfn., m.f. (~ā, ~ī) and n. [ ts ], 1. ( mfn. ) ( i ) (what/who is) bad, evil, wicked; morally wrong; injurious (with unpleasant consequences); Vin II 196, 5 (yāva ~o ayaṃ Devadatto alakkhiko); III 19, 28 (atthi me ~aṃ kammaṃ kataṃ purāṇadutiyikāya methuno dhammo paṭisevito, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-kammaṃ); IV 157, 31 (nārahatāyaṃ puriso ~o hotuṃ yathā bhagavantaṃ payirupāsatī ti); A V 86, 20 foll. (ko paccayo ~assa kammassa kiriyāya ~assa kammassa pavattiyā ti); Dhp 136 (atha ~āni kammāni karaṃ bālo na bujjhati); Sn 57 (~aṃ sahāyaṃ parivajjayetha); Pv 3:2 (samaṇo ahaṃ ~o); Th 1018 (~o kāpurisena saṅgamo); Ja III 476, 6 (mātugāmo nāma ~o nillajjo akataññū mittadubbhī ti); IV 53, 7* (~āni kammāni vivajjayāma; 54, 8´ foll.: sabbāni nirayagāmīni lāmakakammāni); 430, 19 (āvuso Devadatto sayaṃ pi ~o parisā pi ’ssa ~ā, iti so ~o °-parivāro va viharatī ti); VI 236, 31* (~aṃ sahāyaṃ āgamma bahuṃ ~aṃ kataṃ mayā); 239, 8* (kalyāṇaṃ yadi vā ~aṃ na hi kammaṃ panassati); Cp 2:5:4 (ath’ ettha kapi-m-āgantvā ~o anariyo lahu; Cp-a 141, 15 : ~o ti lāmako); Mil 122, 20 (coriyā dhuttiyā … ~iyā, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se pāpikāya); Pj II 109, 15 (dasavatthukāya °-diṭṭhiyā samannāgatattā ~o); — ( ii ) bad, unpleasant; poor, inferior; Ja V 441, 2 (hatthapādamukha-akkhināsāni ~āni virūpāni ahesuṃ, tena naṃ Pañcapāpā t’ eva sañjāniṃsu); — 2. ( m.f. ) a bad or evil person; a wrong-doer; Vin III 90, 26* (~ā ~ehi kammehi nirayaṃ te upapajjare) = Dhp 307; M I 125, 20 (~i dāsi divā uṭṭhāsī ti, Be, Ee so; Ce ~ī dāsī; Se pāpadāsi; Ps II 99, 10 : atha kasmā ~i dāsi divā uṭṭhāsī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pāpadāsi); Dhp 119 (~o pi passatī bhadraṃ yāva ~aṃ na paccati; Dhp-a III 14, 8 : ~o ti kāyaduccaritādinā °-kammena yuttapuggalo); Ja I 488, 17 (~e nissāya hi sukhaṃ nāma natthi); II 136, 26 (sā pi ~ā puna manasā pi aticarituṃ nāsakkhi); IV 91, 9 (so pi ~o … Bārāṇasiṃ agamāsi); Cp 2:8:7 (pathaṃ ~ass’ adās’ ahaṃ); Dhp-a II 72, 20 (iminā kira ~ena paccekabuddho pahaṭo); Mhv 34:14 (lokantarikanirayaṃ ~o so upapajjatha); — 3. ( n., pl. acc. also pāpe) ( i ) evil, wrong-doing; a bad, injurious action (involving unpleasant consequences); Abh 84; Vin I 73, 28 (mayaṃ kho yuddhābhinandino gacchantā ~aṃ ca karoma bahuṃ ca apuññaṃ pasavāma); III 72, 7 (kataṃ tayā kalyāṇaṃ akataṃ tayā ~aṃ, kiṃ tuyh’ iminā pāpakena dujjīvitena); D I 52, 29 (yo … pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya natthi tatonidānaṃ ~aṃ natthi ~assa āgamo); S I 12, 19* (~aṃ na kayirā vacasā manasā kāyena vā kiñcana sabbaloke); Bv 2:12 (yathā pi ~e vijjante kalyāṇam api vijjati); Mil 256, 17 (ajānantena pi kataṃ ~aṃ abhisamayantarāyakaraṃ hoti); Vism 465, 1 foll. (attānaṃ garuṃ katvā hiriyā ~aṃ jahāti … paraṃ garuṃ katvā ottappena ~aṃ jahāti); Sp 59, 20 (ahaṃ bhante ekaṃ amaccaṃ … adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametvā uposathaṃ kārehī ti pahiṇiṃ, so … ettake bhikkhū jīvitā voropesi, etaṃ ~aṃ kassa hotīti); 60, 8 (sace te natthi cittaṃ natthi ~aṃ); — ( ii ) evil, a bad thing; trouble; Dhp 119 (~o pi passatī bhadraṃ yāva ~aṃ na paccati yadā ca paccatī ~aṃ atha ~o ~āni passati; Dhp-a III 14, 15 : diṭṭhadhamme vividhā kammakāraṇā samparāye ca apāyadukkhaṃ anubhonto so ~o ~āni passati); Ja II 146, 16* (sabbe bhadrāni passantu mā kañci ~am āgamā; 146, 23´ : ekaṃ pi sattaṃ ~aṃ lāmakaṃ dukkhaṃ mā āgamā); III 418, 18* (āgamissati me ~aṃ āgamissati me bhayaṃ; 418, 20´ : ~an ti lāmakaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ akantaṃ); — pāpā in Ee at Th 771 is wr for pādā ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — ° âdhimuttika , mfn. , whose inclinations are bad; intent on evil; Vibh 341, 28 ; — ° âbhijātika , mfn. , of low birth; M II 222, 15 ; — °’- iccha , mfn. , whose wishes are blameworthy or base (who pretends to have excellent qualities in a wish for gain); Vin I 97, 10 (yo bhikkhu ~o icchāpakato asantaṃ abhūtaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ ullapati); II 196, 24 (mā ~ā pakkhaṃ nissāya saṅghaṃ bhindeyyuṃ); 203, 2 (~-tā °-mittatā); D III 246, 29 (~o hoti micchādiṭṭhi); S I 150, 4 (~ā bhante SāriputtaMoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā ti); A V 150, 9 (~ā bhikkhave nigaṇṭhā); It 34, 16* (~o ahiriko anādaro); Sn 280; Th 987; Mil 357, 8 (puggalo ~o icchāpakato kuhako luddho …); Vism 24, 1 (~assā ti asantaguṇadīpanakāmassa); — °’- icchā , f. , a blameworthy or base desire; Vibh 389, 35 ; — °’- ū̆pasevanā , f. , association with evil people; Ja VI 235, 29 ; — °- kamma , n. and mf ( n )., 1. ( n. ) an evil or wicked deed; a morally wrong action; D III 182, 4 ; M I 39, 10 (Bāhukāya ca pana nadiyā bahujano ~aṃ kataṃ pavāhetī ti, Be, Se so; Ce pāpakaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ; Ee pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ); Pv 7:2 (~aṃ karitvāna petalokaṃ ito gatā); Ja I 130, 10´ foll.; Nidd I 404, 8 (na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ ~aṃ vyantīhoti); Mil 84, 13 ; — 2. ( mf. ) acting wickedly; a wrong-doer; M II 80, 7 (~ā pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti); A III 354, 6* ; Vv 84:30; Thī 452 (socanti ~ā vinipāte °-buddhino); — neg. apāpakamma, mf ( n )., Ja V 412, 3´ ; — °- kammanta , m.f. and n. , 1. ( n. ) an evil deed; a wrong action; Nidd I 405, 31* (tesaṃ ca ~aṃ avipakkaṃ kataṃ bahuṃ); — °- kammi(n) , m.f. , (one) whose actions are evil; a wrong-doer; M I 39, 18* (na hi naṃ sodhaye ~inaṃ); Dhp 126; Thī 242 (corā ca vajjhaghātā ca ye aññe ~ino); Ja V 270, 19´ (bahū ~ino); VI 105, 3* (niraye tāva passāmi āvāse ~inaṃ); Vism 548, 28 (~ino puggalassa); Dhp-a II 9, 7 ; — neg. apāpakammi(n), m.f. , Ja V 411, 30* ; — supāpakammi(n), m.f. , a great wrong-doer; Ja V 143, 13* ; — °- garahi(n) , mfn. , censuring wrong-doing or wrong-doers; S I 63, 32 (~ī bhante āyasmā Sāriputto; Spk I 124, 5 foll.: °-puggale pi garahati … °-dhamme pi garahatī ti); Mil 380, 22 ; Vism 239, 11 ; Sp 740, 30 (~i-tāya); Spk III 223, 1 (~issa dhātuyo); Dhp-a I 17, 15* ; — °- cetasa , mfn. , whose thinking is evil or wrong; S I 70, 33* = It 45, 16* (It-a II 2, 21 : ~an ti akusaladhammasamāyogato lāmakacittaṃ); Pv 38:21 (puriso ~o); — °- jigucchaka , mfn. , spurning, recoiling from, morally wrong action; Ps II 43, 21 ≠ Spk I 126, 28 ; — °- jegucchi(n) , mfn. , detesting, recoiling from, morally wrong action; Mil 352, 10 ; — °- tara , mfn. , (what is) worse; (who is) more wrong; A II 222, 22 (pāpaṃ ca vo bhikkhave desessāmi pāpena ~aṃ); 222, 29 (katamo … pāpena ~o); Ja I 158, 25´ ; IV 405, 12* (pāpā ~o hoti); V 507, 17 (pāpamittasaṃsaggato ca ~aṃ nāma natthī ti); Sadd 792, 11 ; — °- tama , mfn. , most evil; worst; Sadd 792, 11 ; — °- dhammi(n) , mfn. , of evil ways; — supāpadhammi(n), mfn. , of very evil ways; Pv 11:7; Ja VI 107, 22* ; — °- bhīru , mfn. , fearful of doing wrong; scrupulous; Abh 158 (ottappaṃ ~-tā); Cp-a 202, 8 ; 227, 17 (nirayabhayaṃ ~-tā rajjajigucchā); — °- bhīruka , mfn. , id.; Vism 7, 26 ; Spk II 142, 18 (ottāpino ~ā); — °- bhūmi , mfn. , with inferior, poor, soil; S IV 315, 5 (ekaṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ … ~i … aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ … ~ī ti, Be so; Ce, Se ~i … ~in ti; Ee °-bhūmikaṃ … ~in ti); — °- mitta , m. and mfn. , 1.
